summary.summary: Nasdaq momentum continues post-Broadcom blowout earnings while breadth deterioration intensifies. S&P 500 snapped 3-week win streak on Dec 13 with 10 consecutive days of negative breadth. FOMC meeting Dec 17-18 looms as dominant risk event — 96% probability of 25bp cut priced in, but hawkish dot plot risk is elevated. Tech mega-caps and AI/quantum/drone thematic plays dominate volume while cyclicals (Energy -2%, Materials 10-day decline) are under sustained pressure. Bitcoin above $105K supporting crypto-adjacent names. MicroStrategy Nasdaq-100 inclusion (effective Dec 23) announced Dec 13, creating forced passive buying setup. Honeywell announced aerospace breakup exploration on Dec 16 pre-market. Key risk: breadth divergence from index levels signals fragile underpinnings.

scenarios.trade: Broadcom delivered the most important AI earnings since Nvidia breakout. The $60-90B TAM for custom AI chips from just 3 hyperscaler customers fundamentally rerates the company. Weekend analyst notes will upgrade estimates. Institutional buyers who missed Friday move will chase Monday. Market cap nearing $1T milestone provides psychological pull.

scenarios.implication: Stock already moved 14%+ post-earnings — easy money is gone. FOMC risk on Wednesday could cap upside. Profit-taking from Friday buyers. If market breadth deterioration continues, even strong earners can fade.

scenarios.trade: Marvell is the purest secondary beneficiary of Broadcom custom AI ASIC narrative. If the market is repricing AVGO AI opportunity at $60-90B TAM, MRVL share of that market also gets repriced. Analyst upgrades ongoing — Benchmark raised to $135. Custom silicon for 3 hyperscalers provides revenue visibility. Lower market cap than AVGO means higher beta on the same theme.

scenarios.implication: Already ran 23% on its own earnings — momentum exhaustion risk. FOMC Wednesday creates a ceiling. If AVGO fades, MRVL fades harder as derivative play. Valuation stretched after recent run.

scenarios.trade: Activist breakup announcements in mega-cap industrials historically generate 5-10% upside as the conglomerate discount gets priced out. Elliott is one of the most successful activists. Aerospace is a premium business (defense + commercial aviation demand). The announcement creates a floor under the stock as the market prices in sum-of-parts valuation. HON hit ATH last month on Elliott stake news — this is the next catalyst in the arc.

scenarios.implication: Exploration is not execution — company said considering not will separate. Update not expected until January earnings. Market may view this as a stalling tactic. Industrials broadly weak on breadth deterioration. FOMC risk caps upside for all names this week.

scenarios.trade: Alphabet has dual tailwinds: the Willow quantum chip provides a narrative catalyst (even if commercial application is years away), while the $185B capex commitment signals aggressive AI infrastructure buildout that benefits the entire AI supply chain. Stock jumped 6% on Willow announcement — still digesting. Sector leadership (Communication Services positive last week) confirms institutional rotation into the name.

scenarios.implication: Quantum computing is years from commercial viability — narrative can fade quickly. DOJ antitrust case against Google search monopoly is an overhang. FOMC risk. Stock already captured the initial Willow pop.

scenarios.trade: Index inclusion is one of the most mechanically reliable catalysts in equities. $2.1B in estimated passive buying equals ~20% of daily volume. ETFs that track Nasdaq-100 (QQQ alone is massive) MUST buy shares before Dec 23. Monday Dec 16 is when smart money front-runs this forced buying. Bitcoin above $105K provides fundamental tailwind. MSTR will be 40th largest holding at 0.47% weight.

scenarios.implication: Stock already up 547% YTD — extremely crowded and volatile. MicroStrategy fell 5% on Dec 16 in actual trading as Bitcoin volatility whipsawed the name. Buy-the-rumor-sell-the-news risk is real. If Bitcoin drops below $100K, MSTR could cascade. The forced buying thesis is well-known and may already be front-run.

scenarios.trade: When the energy sector enters a multi-day selling cascade, oilfield services stocks like SLB amplify the move because they have operational leverage to oil prices and E&P capex expectations. The 5.5M barrel inventory build signals oversupply. OPEC+ demand forecasts are being revised down. Fund flows actively rotating out of energy into tech/AI. SLB is the highest-volume oilfield services name, providing liquidity for the short. Materials also deeply weak (10-day decline) confirming cyclical sector rotation.

scenarios.implication: Energy is deeply oversold — any positive headline (OPEC cut, Middle East escalation, China stimulus surprise) could trigger a vicious short squeeze. Syria regime change could theoretically disrupt oil flows (has not so far). SLB has strong fundamentals (international revenue diversification) that may attract value buyers.
